prefix.description: SEL-710-5 Motor Protection Relay product prefix

part_number.note: 21-digit MOT string. Positions 10-11 (Slot C), 12-13 (Slot D), 14-15 (Slot E) and 16-17 (Slot Z) are anchored by the drawing layers and confirmed by real part numbers. Positions 6-9, 18-21 come from the ordering information, confirmed by real part numbers. Layer-anchor corrections: the drawing layer group COMBINED_SLOT_B (source.position 8) actually describes the Slot B Ethernet/rear-serial field, which real part numbers place at position 19 - position 8-9 is instead Slot A power-supply | digital-input voltage.

example_part_numbers.note: English, 110-250V PS/125V DI, Slot C (4)AI/(4)AO, Slot D (4)DI/(4)DO Fast Hybrid 125V, Slot E (4)AF/(3)Motor-DIFF, Slot Z 5A/5A, 2x16 LCD+PTC, Single 10/100Base-T EIA-485, no add'l protocol, no coat
Spanish UI, 110-250V PS/125V DI, Slot C (14)DI 125V, Slot D (10)RTD, Slot E (3)Sync-Motor/(3)Motor-DIFF, Slot Z 5A/5A, 5" touchscreen+IRIG-B, Dual 10/100Base-T, IEC61850+DNP3+IEC60870-5-103
From a live relay driver string; trailing config fields shown with 'X' fillers (unset)

positions.label: Advanced Firmware Features
positions.note: Only None (0) currently offered - fixed digit.

positions.label: Slot A Power Supply | Digital Input Voltage
positions.note: Base-unit Slot A. First digit = power-supply voltage, second digit = digital-input voltage. NOT Slot B (the drawing layer that claims position 8 actually describes Slot B Ethernet at position 19).

positions.label: Slot C card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Slot digital-input voltage (A-H) for DI cards, None (X/0) for analog/serial/empty cards. Exceptions encoded in the second digit: for the (8) DO card (card type 2) it is the output Form configuration (A=Form A, B=Form B, C=6 Form A/2 Form B, D=2 Form A/6 Form B, G=4 Form A/4 Form B); for Slot E card type 7 it is the arc-flash/motor variant (4, 5, 6). Because Form letters reuse the voltage letters, an (8) DO code such as 2A decodes here as a voltage - read the Form from this note.

options.6: (4) AI / (4) AO (±20 mA or ±10 V Range)
options.C: (4) DI / (4) DO Fast High-Current Hybrid (Form A)
options.D: (4) DI / (3) DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

options.4: Card 7 variant: (4) Arc-Flash Detection Inputs / (3) Motor DIFF AC Current Inputs (1A/5A)
options.5: Card 7 variant: (3) Synchronous Motor Inputs / (3) Motor DIFF AC Current Inputs (1A/5A)

positions.label: Slot D card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Slot digital-input voltage (A-H) for DI cards, None (X/0) for analog/serial/empty cards. Exceptions encoded in the second digit: for the (8) DO card (card type 2) it is the output Form configuration (A=Form A, B=Form B, C=6 Form A/2 Form B, D=2 Form A/6 Form B, G=4 Form A/4 Form B); for Slot E card type 7 it is the arc-flash/motor variant (4, 5, 6). Because Form letters reuse the voltage letters, an (8) DO code such as 2A decodes here as a voltage - read the Form from this note. Slot D uniquely offers the (10) RTD card (9).

options.6: (4) AI / (4) AO (±20 mA or ±10 V Range)
options.C: (4) DI / (4) DO Fast High-Current Hybrid (Form A)
options.D: (4) DI / (3) DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

options.4: Card 7 variant: (4) Arc-Flash Detection Inputs / (3) Motor DIFF AC Current Inputs (1A/5A)
options.5: Card 7 variant: (3) Synchronous Motor Inputs / (3) Motor DIFF AC Current Inputs (1A/5A)

positions.label: Slot E card | DI voltage / variant
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Slot digital-input voltage (A-H) for DI cards, None (X/0) for analog/serial/empty cards. Exceptions encoded in the second digit: for the (8) DO card (card type 2) it is the output Form configuration (A=Form A, B=Form B, C=6 Form A/2 Form B, D=2 Form A/6 Form B, G=4 Form A/4 Form B); for Slot E card type 7 it is the arc-flash/motor variant (4, 5, 6). Because Form letters reuse the voltage letters, an (8) DO code such as 2A decodes here as a voltage - read the Form from this note. Slot E uniquely offers the arc-flash / motor-differential card (7).

options.6: (4) AI / (4) AO (±20 mA or ±10 V Range)
options.7: Arc-Flash / Motor-Differential card (second digit selects variant)
options.C: (4) DI / (4) DO Fast High-Current Hybrid (Form A)
options.D: (4) DI / (3) DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

options.4: Card 7 variant: (4) Arc-Flash Detection Inputs / (3) Motor DIFF AC Current Inputs (1A/5A)
options.5: Card 7 variant: (3) Synchronous Motor Inputs / (3) Motor DIFF AC Current Inputs (1A/5A)

positions.label: Slot Z Current & Voltage Inputs
positions.note: Base-unit current/voltage input card. First digit = card type, second = phase/neutral current rating. The Rogowski/LEA option is the single atomic code L1 (card L); its second digit '1' is part of that package, not the 1A/1A rating.

options.8: 3-Phase AC Voltages (300 Vac) + phase/neutral AC current inputs
options.L: Rogowski Coil / Low-Power CT + 3-Phase LEA Voltage Sensor (RJ45); SELect (4) ACI / (3) AVI (code L1)

positions.label: Front Panel | Slot B IRIG-B/PTC Option
positions.note: PTC only available with No Ethernet or Single 10/100Base-T Slot B options.

positions.label: Slot B Ethernet (Port 1) | Rear Serial Port (Port 3)
positions.note: Drawing layer group COMBINED_SLOT_B lists these codes but with source.position 8; real part numbers place this field at position 19. EIA-485 only with No Ethernet or Single 10/100Base-T.

positions.label: Protocol (IEC 61850 | DNP3 | IEC 60870-5-103 | EtherNet/IP)
positions.note: IEC 61850 and EtherNet/IP available only with Slot B Ethernet options.

positions.label: Conformal Coat
positions.note: Live relay part-number strings sometimes show 'X' here when the field is unset.
